Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait.tagline: someone who lets me play an extra land, no questions asked
match: Match! Two lands a turn, a card every time. I'm a provider.
It's a match. Come swim in Gyre Strait. The water's full of cards.
reject: Sorry, I'm a tyrant. Tyrants don't do compromise.
No. You're cute, but I'd rather draw another card.
Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait.comeback: Fine. One extra land drop for you. Don't waste it.

Alela, Cunning Conqueror.tagline: someone who doesn't mind that I make my moves on other people's turns
match: I cast spells on your turn just to get your attention. Faerie, take a bow.
My Faeries hit your heart and now everyone else starts fighting over you.
reject: I flash in, I flash out. You get the flash out.
I goad my enemies into fighting. You? I'll just ignore.
Alela, Cunning Conqueror.comeback: Cunning, remember? I knew you'd ask. Instant speed, yes.

Aminatou, the Fateshifter.tagline: someone who doesn't mind when fate swaps everything around
match: I already saw this in the top card. It said yes.
Good choice. I'll blink your best creature, so it comes back fresh.
reject: I drew a card and put one back on top. That was my answer.
Fate shifted. To the left, away from you.
Aminatou, the Fateshifter.comeback: Fine. Fate shifts. Sometimes even back to you.

Animar, Soul of Elements.tagline: someone who casts creatures until everything costs nothing
match: Match! Every creature you cast makes me cheaper. In a good way.
It's a match. Pro-white, pro-black, pro-you.
reject: Sorry, I have protection from exactly this.
No. My counters say I've outgrown this.
Animar, Soul of Elements.comeback: Fine. Cast one more creature and I'll cost you a little less.

Anowon, the Ruin Thief.tagline: someone with a big library and no plans to keep it
match: My Rogues get +1/+1 just for standing next to me. Imagine what you'll get.
I steal hearts, then libraries. Usually in that order.
reject: I've robbed ruins with more personality.
I'd mill you, but there's nothing in there I want.
Anowon, the Ruin Thief.comeback: Fine. A good thief always comes back for a second look.

Arcades, the Strategist.tagline: someone who sees past my walls and lets them attack
match: Match! You saw past my walls. Most people only see the walls.
It's a match. I'll draw a card for every wall you bring home.
reject: Sorry, I've got defender up. Emotionally, too.
No. A true strategist knows when to stay behind the wall.
Arcades, the Strategist.comeback: Fine. One wall comes down. It hits for its toughness, though.

Atla Palani, Nest Tender.tagline: someone ready to start a family, even if we don't know what will hatch
match: I tap, we get an Egg. Every Egg is a surprise. Let's raise them together.
Our first Egg is already on the battlefield. What's in it? Nobody knows!
reject: I'm not putting all my eggs in your basket.
Something cracked, and it wasn't the Egg. It was my interest.
Atla Palani, Nest Tender.comeback: Okay. Let's hatch this and see what comes out of it.

Atraxa, Praetors' Voice.tagline: someone who proliferates every relationship I'm in
match: Four colors of baggage, but it all grows on you. One counter per turn.
It's a match! My Superfriends will love you. Yes, all of them. At once.
reject: I proliferate many things. This relationship isn't one of them.
Sorry, my polycule is full. The planeswalkers got here first.
Atraxa, Praetors' Voice.comeback: Fine. I'll put one counter on us and see if it grows by my end step.

Bello, Bard of the Brambles.tagline: someone with expensive furniture that can throw a punch
match: On my turn your fancy artifacts become 4/4s. Imagine what I'll do for you.
I'm a raccoon bard. I sing, I steal snacks, I animate your enchantments.
reject: I've seen your trinkets. None of them cost four mana or more.
This raccoon is going back to the bushes. Alone. With his lute.
Bello, Bard of the Brambles.comeback: Fine, I'll write you one more song. Let's hope it's not a breakup ballad.

Brago, King Eternal.tagline: someone who won't mind being blinked out of existence for a moment
match: Match! I'll hit you, blink you, and you'll feel brand new.
It's a match. Mind if I bring Winter Orb? It sets the mood.
reject: Sorry, I blinked and you were gone. Forever.
No. A king eternal has all eternity to find someone better.
Brago, King Eternal.comeback: Fine. Exile, then return. Consider yourself reset.

Breya, Etherium Shaper.tagline: someone who loves me for my metal parts too
match: Match! I made us two Thopters. Flying chaperones.
Half of me is etherium. The other half already likes you.
reject: I sacrificed two artifacts for this answer. It deals three damage to you.
Four colors of options, and none of them is you.
Breya, Etherium Shaper.comeback: Fine. Sacrifice two artifacts, gain five life. Call it emotional healing.

Captain N'ghathrod.tagline: someone with an open mind, ideally a delicious one
match: I'd love to pick your brain. Literally. Welcome aboard the nautiloid.
Your opponents' graveyards are my dating pool. You get menace, I get their stuff.
reject: I tasted your mind. Bland.
My tentacles are already holding someone else's library.
Captain N'ghathrod.comeback: Fine. Climb aboard. Mind the tadpoles.

Chulane, Teller of Tales.tagline: someone with a good story, ideally one that draws me a card
match: Match! Let me tell you a tale. It's long, and every chapter draws a card.
Every time you show up, I draw a card and play a land. Real growth.
reject: I've heard this story before. I'm bouncing it back to your hand.
Not every tale has a happy ending. This one draws a card and moves on.
Chulane, Teller of Tales.comeback: Fine. I'll return you to hand and recast you. Fresh ETB, fresh start.

Clavileño, First of the Blessed.tagline: a vampire with a little demon inside, waiting to come out
match: Attack with me and I'll bring out the demon in you. Literally.
A bat, a vampire and a priest walk into a bar. It's all me. Hi.
reject: The blessing is for vampires. You're clearly just a tourist.
I've seen your sins, and none of them are the fun kind.
Clavileño, First of the Blessed.comeback: Fine. Everyone deserves one blessing. Don't waste it.

Dragonlord Ojutai.tagline: someone patient enough to wait until I'm tapped and vulnerable
match: I'm only hexproof while untapped. For you, I'll attack and let my guard down.
Every hit, I look at three cards and keep the best. Today that's you.
reject: Untapped, untargetable, unavailable.
I looked at three options. You went to the bottom.
Dragonlord Ojutai.comeback: Fine. I'll tap for you. Once. Don't make me regret being vulnerable.

Edgar Markov.tagline: someone who appreciates old money and older blood
match: Match! Every Vampire you bring home gets a plus-one. Family tradition.
Charmed. I've sat in the command zone longer than your bloodline has existed.
reject: I'm afraid the family wouldn't approve. And there are a lot of us.
You lack a certain... vintage, darling.
Edgar Markov.comeback: Very well. One more drink, darling. Then we'll discuss your blood type.

Ellivere of the Wild Court.tagline: someone who's into a little roleplay
match: I'm into roleplay. Literally: your best creature gets a Virtuous Role from me.
Enchanted creature connects, I draw a card. Our fairy tale writes itself.
reject: Sorry, the only Role I have left for you is Cursed.
This isn't that kind of fairy tale. No happy ending, no kiss.
Ellivere of the Wild Court.comeback: Fine. Every fairy tale needs a second act. Don't miss your cue.

Elsha of the Infinite.tagline: someone who doesn't mind me peeking at what's coming next
match: I always know what's on top of your library. I saw this coming.
With me, everything happens at instant speed. Even falling for you.
reject: I peeked at the top of your library. I've seen enough.
Infinite patience, they said. They lied.
Elsha of the Infinite.comeback: Fine. I'll cast you off the top again, with flash.

Etali, Primal Conqueror.tagline: someone who doesn't mind me casting spells from their ex's library
match: I take a spell from every library at the table and cast them all for you.
Free spells for everyone! Well, for me. And now you.
reject: Everyone exiles their top card, and so do I. Exiled: this date.
Give it time and I transform into something worse. Run while you can.
Etali, Primal Conqueror.comeback: Fine, I'll stay the dinosaur version of me. No poison tonight.

Ezuri, Renegade Leader.tagline: someone who gets along with my forty Elves
match: Match! Five mana and every Elf gets +3/+3. Let's make it a party.
It's a match. I'm a renegade. My Elves and I don't follow rules.
reject: Sorry, my Elves voted. It wasn't close.
No. I'd regenerate this, but it's not an Elf.
Ezuri, Renegade Leader.comeback: Fine. One green mana and I'll regenerate what we had.

Feather, the Redeemed.tagline: someone who targets me with love, again and again
match: Match! Target me with something sweet and it comes back every turn.
It's a match. I'm redeemed. Mostly. Fling is still on the table.
reject: Sorry, I've been redeemed. I'm not going back to that.
No. If it doesn't target me, it doesn't come back.
Feather, the Redeemed.comeback: Fine. Every spell comes back at end step. Why not you?

Galadriel, Light of Valinor.tagline: someone who can resist the Ring, and maybe also me
match: I passed the test. I will not diminish. I'll go into the West with you.
Look into my mirror. It shows what was, what is, and us.
reject: All shall love me and despair. You're in the despair part.
I refused the One Ring. Refusing you was much easier.
Galadriel, Light of Valinor.comeback: Fine. Even the Lady of Lórien gives a second gift sometimes.

Ghave, Guru of Spores.tagline: a fun guy who doesn't mind a little Ashnod's Altar in the bedroom
match: I'm a fun-gi. Bring an altar and we'll go infinite tonight.
Counters become Saprolings, Saprolings become counters. We just click.
reject: I recycle everything. Except this date. That goes straight to the bin.
Spore-adic interest at best. Sorry, I'm going to mushroom elsewhere.
Ghave, Guru of Spores.comeback: Fine, I'll sacrifice my pride and put a counter on you instead.

Giada, Font of Hope.tagline: someone who believes in angels, plural
match: Match! You enter with a +1/+1 counter for every Angel who already loves you.
Heavenly. Meet the choir. Each one makes the next one stronger.
reject: My mana is only for Angels. You're lovely, but you're no Angel.
Sorry, I'm mono-white. I have principles, and you're not one of them.
Giada, Font of Hope.comeback: Fine. I'm literally the Font of Hope. Have some.

Gishath, Sun's Avatar.tagline: someone who isn't afraid of a big family of Dinosaurs
match: Eight mana, haste, trample, and I hit you right in the heart.
I connect and bring the whole herd. My family loves you already.
reject: Love and Dinosaurs: both should have stayed extinct.
I revealed the top of my library. No Dinosaur, no you.
Gishath, Sun's Avatar.comeback: Fine, I'll reveal some more cards. Maybe there's a Dino for you.

Gonti, Lord of Luxury.tagline: someone who leaves their top four cards unattended
match: I went through your top four and kept your best secret. Face down, of course.
My kind doesn't live long, so let's go somewhere expensive. You're paying.
reject: I went through your things. Nothing worth stealing.
Lord of Luxury. You're more of a clearance bin.
Gonti, Lord of Luxury.comeback: Fine. I'll keep you face down in exile, just in case.

Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.tagline: someone who fills out the forms in triplicate and pays the extra 1
match: Approved. Your spells cost 1 less, everyone else's cost 1 more. You're welcome.
Our relationship has been reviewed, stamped and filed. Congratulations.
reject: Application denied. Please resubmit with 1 additional generic mana.
Talking to me costs 1 more. You couldn't afford the first sentence.
Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.comeback: Fine. Appeal granted. A processing fee applies.

Hakbal of the Surging Soul.tagline: someone who goes exploring with me before every combat
match: Match! Let's explore. Lands go home, everything else gets a counter.
It's a match. My Merfolk already explored your profile. Twice.
reject: Sorry, I'm looking for someone with more Merfolk in their life.
No. I explored you and found nothing worth a counter.
Hakbal of the Surging Soul.comeback: Okay, I'll explore you once more. Try not to be a land this time.

Henzie \"Toolbox\" Torre.tagline: someone who's fine with fast flings that leave a card on the nightstand
match: I blitz in, swing hard, and leave you a card by morning. Classy, right?
Every big creature gets blitz. Every date gets a little cheaper. Efficient.
reject: I sacrificed better at the end of the turn. You're not worth the blitz.
I'm a Riveteer. I fix things. This one isn't worth the tools.
Henzie \"Toolbox\" Torre.comeback: Fine, recast me. Every time I come back, it gets cheaper for you.

Hidetsugu and Kairi.tagline: a third for our very committed ogre-and-dragon duo
match: We draw three, put two back, and keep you. Best Brainstorm ever.
We come as a package deal. Lucky you, it's a big package.
reject: We put you back on top of the library. And then we shuffled.
One of us said maybe. The other one said absolutely not.
Hidetsugu and Kairi.comeback: Fine, we'll cast you for free. Don't make us regret it.

Isshin, Two Heavens as One.tagline: someone whose attack triggers go off twice
match: Match! When you go on the attack, I trigger an additional time.
Two heavens as one. You and me, but every feeling doubled.
reject: Your attack triggered nothing in me. Not even once.
I'm a samurai. I've made my peace, and my peace says no.
Isshin, Two Heavens as One.comeback: Fine. A second chance, and like everything with me, it triggers twice.

Jetmir, Nexus of Revels.tagline: someone who brings friends, because I only get better with a crowd
match: Three's company, six tramples, nine gets double strike. Bring everybody.
Welcome to the Cabaretti. Your name's on the list and the drinks are free.
reject: Sorry, the club's at capacity. And you're not on the list.
You came alone? To my party? Bouncer, please.
Jetmir, Nexus of Revels.comeback: Fine, the velvet rope opens. But you're buying the next round.

Jodah, the Unifier.tagline: someone legendary, because I only date legends
match: Match! Every legend we add makes us both bigger. That's unity.
It's a match. Five colors, one heart, and a free legend off the top.
reject: Sorry, I only date legends. You're more of a common.
No. I exiled half my library looking for you. You never showed.
Jodah, the Unifier.comeback: Fine. Maybe you're legendary after all. Prove it.

Kaalia of the Vast.tagline: someone who can handle an Angel, a Demon and a Dragon at once
match: Match! I'll bring a friend. Tapped and attacking, but a friend.
You survived until turn four with me. That's basically marriage.
reject: No. My type is Angel, Demon or Dragon. You're none of them.
Sorry, I skip the courtship and go straight to attacking.
Kaalia of the Vast.comeback: Fine. But if nobody removes me by turn four, you're mine.

Kalamax, the Stormsire.tagline: someone who lets me lie down first, since I copy best when tapped
match: Your first instant each turn? I'll copy it. Some things are worth doing twice.
Every copy makes me grow. A dinosaur who thrives on repetition.
reject: For you, I'm tapped out. Permanently.
I copy instants, not mistakes.
Kalamax, the Stormsire.comeback: Fine. First instant this turn, and I'll copy the apology too.

Kefka, Court Mage.tagline: someone who laughs at the end of the world with me
match: Match! Everyone discard a card, it's a party! Hee hee hee!
It's a match. I'll ruin everyone else, just for you.
reject: Sorry! I've decided to destroy you instead. Nothing personal. Hee hee!
No. You're like a broken record! A broken, boring record!
Kefka, Court Mage.comeback: Fine, fine! Your misery is just too much fun to throw away.

Kenrith, the Returned King.tagline: someone who appreciates a king with a gift in every color
match: Match! You get five life, a card and a +1/+1 counter. I'm a giver.
I came back from the dead for this date. It's literally in my name.
reject: I can return creatures from any graveyard. I can't return this feeling.
Five abilities, and not one of them is for you.
Kenrith, the Returned King.comeback: Fine. I came back once. Maybe you can too.

Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy.tagline: someone who produces a little extra, like every mana rock I own
match: Match! You tap, I add one more. With a Basalt Monolith, we're infinite.
I'm the darling of cEDH. Give it a turn and you'll be one too.
reject: Sorry, I only bond with mana rocks. You don't tap for anything.
I looked at the top five cards of my library. None of them was you.
Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy.comeback: Fine. Tap once and I'll add one additional chance. That's just how I work.

Kodama of the East Tree.tagline: someone open to Partners, I already have one but there's room in the tree
match: Every time someone moves in, I let someone cheaper move in too. Welcome!
I have Partner, but the tree's big. Pull up a branch.
reject: Something entered, but it wasn't my feelings for you.
You've got reach. Not enough to reach me, though.
Kodama of the East Tree.comeback: A permanent with equal or lesser value? You'll do. Come in.

Korvold, Fae-Cursed King.tagline: someone I won't have to sacrifice on our first date
match: Match! I sacrificed a Food to celebrate. And drew a card. And grew.
You'd look great at my table. Everything there gets eaten eventually.
reject: I have to sacrifice something to attack. Sadly, you're not worth a card.
My curse says I must give something up. Today it's you.
Korvold, Fae-Cursed King.comeback: Fine. I'll sacrifice my pride instead. Look, I drew a card.

Krenko, Mob Boss.tagline: someone who doesn't mind that I bring the whole family
match: Match! I'll tell the boys. All of them. The number just doubled again.
Great, a table for two. Plus however many Goblins I control. Make it fifty.
reject: The family voted. It wasn't close, there are 64 of us.
Sorry, the boys don't like you. And the boys outnumber you.
Krenko, Mob Boss.comeback: Okay, okay. The family says one more chance. They doubled while we talked.

Kykar, Wind's Fury.tagline: someone who keeps casting spells, so the Spirits never run out
match: Cast me a spell and I'll make you a Spirit. Cast ten and we're comboing tonight.
A bird who turns ghosts into mana. Low maintenance, high storm count.
reject: Even my Spirits are flying away from this one.
Sorry, I'm going out with someone who brings more cantrips.
Kykar, Wind's Fury.comeback: Fine. One more cantrip, and a Spirit comes along as chaperone.

Lathril, Blade of the Elves.tagline: someone who can keep up with ten Elves tapping at once
match: Match! Ten Elves are tapping for you. Drain ten, gain ten, that's chemistry.
Menace means it takes two to stop me. Good thing I only want one.
reject: Sorry, I'm a precon. My heart was pre-constructed without you.
My Elves tapped ten times. Every single one was a no.
Lathril, Blade of the Elves.comeback: Fine, the Elves outvoted me. The Elves always outvote me.

Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice.tagline: someone who showers me in Auras and loves the fox ears
match: Match! For every Aura you give me, I'll fetch a matching one. Twinning!
It's a match. I wear Auras like jewelry. You could be the next one.
reject: Sorry, the Emperor's Voice says no.
No. I'm already wearing six Auras. There's no room for you.
Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice.comeback: Fine. You can attach yourself to me. Just this once.

Lord Windgrace.tagline: someone who likes a cat that brings lands back from the dead
match: Match! I'll dig up your old lands and make them feel loved again.
It's a match. My ultimate plan: six cats and a fresh start. Together.
reject: Sorry, I prefer walking the planes alone. Mostly through forests.
No. I discarded you and drew something better. Twice, you were a land.
Lord Windgrace.comeback: Fine. I'll bring you back like a land from my graveyard.

Lord of the Nazgûl.tagline: someone who doesn't mind that I bring eight friends everywhere I go
match: Cast a spell and I'll make you a Wraith. Romance, Mordor style.
One Ring to bind them, and one date to bind you. Precious.
reject: You'd have to cast a lot more instants to impress a Ringwraith.
Nine of us voted. All nine of us whispered no.
Lord of the Nazgûl.comeback: The Ring tempts you, and apparently so do you. Come back.

Magda, Brazen Outlaw.tagline: someone who loves treasure and short people with big axes
match: Every time a Dwarf taps, we get Treasure. Rich and romantic.
Five Treasures and I'll steal anything. Starting with your heart.
reject: Brazen? Yes. Desperate? No.
I'd sacrifice five Treasures for a better date than this.
Magda, Brazen Outlaw.comeback: Fine, the Dwarves voted. They like you. Tap in.

Marwyn, the Nurturer.tagline: someone who nurtures me with every creature that enters
match: Match! Every creature you bring home makes me stronger. And richer.
It's a match. I tap for green equal to my power. I'm a keeper.
reject: Sorry, I nurture Elves, not situations like this.
No. Too few creatures entered here for me to grow.
Marwyn, the Nurturer.comeback: Okay. Bring one more creature and I'll grow on you.

Meren of Clan Nel Toth.tagline: someone with experience, ideally lots of experience counters
match: Match! I have plenty of experience. Counters, to be exact.
When things die around me, I bring them back at my end step. You're safe.
reject: Your mana value is higher than my experience. Back to hand with you.
I bring a lot back from the graveyard. Not this conversation.
Meren of Clan Nel Toth.comeback: Fine. At my end step I return one creature card. Today it's you.

match: Match! You just entered, so now there are two of you. Double date.
I guard my hoard, and now you're in it. Congrats, you're treasure.
reject: Ward 2. You can't even pay to get close.
I only copy Dragons I like. I made zero copies of you.
Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm.comeback: Fine. I'll make a token copy of you. The copy gets the second chance.

Mizzix of the Izmagnus.tagline: someone who appreciates a girl with experience
match: The more experience I gain, the cheaper our dates get.
Bring your biggest instants. With my experience, they cost next to nothing.
reject: Your mana value is below my experience. Nothing left to learn here.
Sorry, I'm not looking to gain experience with you.
Mizzix of the Izmagnus.comeback: Fine. Every relationship is a learning experience. I'll take the counter.

Mr. House, President and CEO.tagline: someone who rolls high and never bets against the house
match: The house always wins, and tonight, darling, so do you.
Roll a 4 and I'll build you a Robot. Roll a 6 and I'll throw in a Treasure.
reject: I ran the numbers. The odds of us were never good.
I've stayed in a pod for two centuries to avoid dates like this one.
Mr. House, President and CEO.comeback: Fine. One more roll. But the house keeps the Treasure.

Ms. Bumbleflower.tagline: someone who shares, because at my table everybody draws
match: Match! I already bought your friends a card. Sharing is caring.
You make me feel like I've gained flying. Until end of turn, at least.
reject: Aww, no. But here, draw a card anyway. Consolation prize.
I hug the whole table, but I'm hopping out of this one.
Ms. Bumbleflower.comeback: Okay! Second chances are like cards: I hand them out to everyone.

Muldrotha, the Gravetide.tagline: someone who doesn't mind that I keep going back to my exes
match: Match! One of each type, every turn. And you're my type.
I'll replay you from my graveyard every turn. That's devotion.
reject: Sorry, I already cast my creature from the graveyard this turn.
You're not my type. I checked every permanent type.
Muldrotha, the Gravetide.comeback: Fine. I always go back to the graveyard for things. Including you.

Najeela, the Blade-Blossom.tagline: someone who wants a date that never ends, one extra combat at a time
match: Five mana and we get another combat. And another. And another.
Every Warrior I bring brings a friend. It's a big, loud wedding.
reject: I am a three-drop of pure cEDH chaos. You can't keep up with that.
I untap all my attackers, but not my feelings for you.
Najeela, the Blade-Blossom.comeback: WUBRG: untap, haste, trample, lifelink. And yes, one more phase with you.

Narset, Enlightened Exile.tagline: someone with a graveyard full of spells worth a second look
match: Every noncreature spell you cast makes me stronger. Prowess is my love language.
I attack, you get a free copy of something from your past. That's growth.
reject: I've meditated on it. The answer is still no.
I only revisit the past when it costs less than my power. You don't.
Narset, Enlightened Exile.comeback: Fine. Exiles know what a second chance is worth.

Nekusar, the Mindrazer.tagline: someone who loves drawing cards, as long as it hurts a little
match: Match! Draw an extra card, darling. It only stings a little.
It's a match. You get more cards, the table gets more pain. Romantic.
reject: No. I've read your mind and frankly, it gave me a headache.
Sorry, I razed your mind and found nothing worth drawing.
Nekusar, the Mindrazer.comeback: Fine, draw one more card. That'll be one damage, sweetheart.

Niv-Mizzet, Parun.tagline: someone who casts instants so I can draw, and ping, and draw
match: Match! Every card I draw sends one damage your enemies' way.
It's a match. Curiosity? Sweetheart, I'm insatiable.
reject: Sorry, six colored pips and you can't even cast me.
No. I am a genius. I've already calculated how this ends.
Niv-Mizzet, Parun.comeback: Fine. You've piqued my curiosity. Don't make me regret it.

Omnath, Locus of Creation.tagline: someone who makes every land drop feel like the first time
match: Match! First land: four life. Second: mana. Third: the table burns.
It's a match. Standard couldn't handle me. Let's see if you can.
reject: Sorry, you only trigger me once a turn. I need three.
No. I've been banned from better relationships than this.
Omnath, Locus of Creation.comeback: Fine. Play one more land and let's see what triggers.

Omnath, Locus of Mana.tagline: someone who lets me keep all my green mana, forever
match: I never let anything go. Including you now. Hope you like green.
Every green mana I hold makes me bigger. You're my favourite one.
reject: My pool never empties, but my patience just did.
I hoard mana, not mistakes. You'd be a mistake.
Omnath, Locus of Mana.comeback: I'm terrible at letting go anyway. Get back in the pool.

Pantlaza, Sun-Favored.tagline: someone who helps me discover something new every turn
match: Match! Let's discover X together. X being how tough you are.
Rawr. That's Dinosaur for 'you have great toughness.'
reject: I discovered you. Then I discovered I'd rather cast something else.
Once each turn I discover something. This turn it wasn't you.
Pantlaza, Sun-Favored.comeback: Fine. Roar, discover, repeat. You get one more turn.

Prosper, Tome-Bound.tagline: someone who plays fast, loose and from exile
match: Match! Every time we do something impulsive, I get a Treasure.
I made a pact with an archfiend. You seem like less of a commitment.
reject: I exiled you at my end step. You had until my next turn. Time's up.
Deathtouch. One touch and this was over before it started.
Prosper, Tome-Bound.comeback: Fine. I'll play you from exile. My favorite way to give chances.

Purphoros, God of the Forge.tagline: someone who brings new friends and doesn't mind when it gets heated
match: Every newcomer burns your opponents for 2. That's how I like a growing family.
Indestructible, good with his hands, always hot. You're welcome.
reject: Show me enough red first. Until then I'm not even a creature.
I forge weapons for gods. I'm not forging a relationship with you.
Purphoros, God of the Forge.comeback: Fine. The iron's still hot. Let's strike.

Queen Marchesa.tagline: someone who knows the crown is mine and stops reaching for it
match: You may approach the throne. Bring a gift, and don't you dare become the monarch.
Date a queen, draw an extra card every end step. Royalty has perks.
reject: The crown says no. The crown is never wrong.
Eyeing my crown? I keep deathtouch assassins for that, darling.
Queen Marchesa.comeback: Fine. The queen is merciful. Once. The assassins stay on call.

Raffine, Scheming Seer.tagline: someone who'll keep my secrets, I already know theirs
match: I saw this coming. I scheme, you connive. We're perfect.
Draw, discard, grow. Our relationship has a plan and I wrote it.
reject: I connived. I discarded. You were the nonland card.
Ward 1, darling. You couldn't even pay the toll.
Raffine, Scheming Seer.comeback: I knew you'd be back. That was step four of the plan.

Rhys the Redeemed.tagline: someone who wants a big family, then doubles it, then doubles it again
match: One mana and I'm yours. Give me a few turns and we'll have a hundred kids.
Every token you make, I copy. Our family tree is going exponential.
reject: I'm a one-drop elf with dynasty plans. You're not dynasty material.
I double what I love. With you there's nothing to double.
Rhys the Redeemed.comeback: Redemption is literally in my name. Second chances are kind of my thing.

Rocco, Street Chef.tagline: someone who doesn't mind me cooking for the whole table
match: I cook for everyone, but you get the +1/+1 counter. That means you're special.
Dinner's on me, and on everyone else at the table. Group hug, baby.
reject: Sorry, the kitchen's closed. Even group hug has limits.
I feed the whole table, but you're eating somewhere else tonight.
Rocco, Street Chef.comeback: Fine, sit down. Nobody leaves Rocco's table hungry.

Satya, Aetherflux Genius.tagline: someone with enough energy to keep up, I copy only the best
match: I'm copying you on the attack. Stick around if you've got the energy.
Genius brain, energy to spare. And now you're my favourite copy.
reject: I'd copy you, but I don't have the energy to keep you.
My genius ran the numbers. You don't pay off.
Satya, Aetherflux Genius.comeback: Fine, here's some energy. Don't make me sacrifice you at the end step.

Sauron, the Dark Lord.tagline: someone to rule them all with, and in the darkness bind them
match: Match! I see you. I always see you. That's not creepy, it's an Eye thing.
One Ring to bind us. Don't worry, it only tempts you a little.
reject: You shall not... wait, that's the other guy. Anyway: no.
Each spell you cast grows my Army. Each word you say shrinks my interest.
Sauron, the Dark Lord.comeback: Very well. The Ring tempts you once more. Do not make me regret this.

Sefris of the Hidden Ways.tagline: someone not afraid to venture into a dungeon or three
match: Want to see my dungeon? Every creature you lose takes us one room deeper.
Complete a dungeon with me and I'll bring your favorite creature back from the dead.
reject: You're not dungeon material. Not even the first room.
I've ventured into worse places than this date. Not many, though.
Sefris of the Hidden Ways.comeback: Fine. Every dungeon has a secret door. You found it.

Selvala, Heart of the Wilds.tagline: someone who knows size matters, at least the greatest power on the table
match: Biggest creature in the room? Draw a card, darling. I'm generous like that.
You bring the beef, I bring X mana. That's what I call chemistry.
reject: I share cards with the whole table. Just not my heart, not with you.
I measure power for a living. Yours didn't make the cut.
Selvala, Heart of the Wilds.comeback: Fine. Everyone gets a card when someone big shows up. Even you.

Shorikai, Genesis Engine.tagline: someone who brings their own pilots, crewing me takes eight power
match: Draw two, discard one, make a Pilot. Our first date runs like clockwork.
I'm a mech, a card engine and an artifact. Your parents will love me.
reject: Crew 8, sweetie. You came with a 1/1.
My engine draws two and discards one. You were the one.
Shorikai, Genesis Engine.comeback: Fine, I'll make you a Pilot and you can drive me home.

Sigarda, Host of Herons.tagline: someone who respects my boundaries and never asks me to sacrifice anything
match: You can't target me, but you somehow got through. Impressive.
Hexproof heart, flying high, and somehow you're on my wing.
reject: Your spells can't make me sacrifice, and neither can your charm.
I'm hexproof to bad dates. This one bounced right off.
Sigarda, Host of Herons.comeback: Fine, I'll let you target me. Just this once.

Sliver Gravemother.tagline: someone who can handle a mom who keeps bringing the kids back from the grave
match: Meet my kids. Then meet them again. They don't stay dead in this house.
I raised a whole hive by myself. One more mouth to feed? Easy.
reject: I raise the dead for a living. Raising my standards was easier.
Mother knows best, sweetie. And mother says no.
Sliver Gravemother.comeback: Everything in my graveyard gets an encore. I suppose you can too.

Sram, Senior Edificer.tagline: someone who gears up, suits up and buckles up
match: Match! Every Aura, Equipment or Vehicle you cast, I draw a card.
It's a match. I'm a senior edificer. I build things that last.
reject: Sorry, nothing in your hand made me want to draw.
No. I've seen sturdier builds in a Kaladesh scrapyard.
Sram, Senior Edificer.comeback: Fine. Let me gear you up and we'll see where it goes.

Sythis, Harvest's Hand.tagline: someone who keeps the enchantments coming
match: Match! Every enchantment you cast: one card, one life, one heart.
It's a match. Pillow fort for two? I'll bring the Auras.
reject: Sorry, the spark just isn't enchanting enough.
No. It takes more than this to draw a nymph in.
Sythis, Harvest's Hand.comeback: Fine. Cast me one more enchantment and we'll see.

Tatyova, Benthic Druid.tagline: someone steady: one land, one card, one life, every time
match: Match! Every land you play, I draw a card and smile.
It's a match. I'm the first Commander half the table ever loved.
reject: Sorry, I'm a simple druid. This felt too complicated.
No. Even a slow landfall deck needs some chemistry.
Tatyova, Benthic Druid.comeback: Okay. Play a land and I'll gain one life. Small steps.

Tergrid, God of Fright.tagline: someone who leaves their stuff at my place, permanently
match: Match! What's yours is mine. Straight from your graveyard.
You discarded your doubts? Great. I control them now.
reject: No. But leave your things here, I'll keep them.
Menace. It would take at least two of you to change my mind.
Tergrid, God of Fright.comeback: Fine. Sacrifice your pride and I'll put it onto the battlefield. Under my control.

Teysa Karlov.tagline: someone who reads the prenup twice, like every death trigger
match: Match! The contract is drafted. Every clause triggers twice.
Your tokens get vigilance and lifelink. Consider it a signing bonus.
reject: My lawyers reviewed you. I am the lawyers. Denied.
Your application died. The rejection triggers an additional time: no, and no.
Teysa Karlov.comeback: Fine. Appeal granted. Sign here, here and here. In triplicate.

The First Sliver.tagline: a partner who loves big families and doesn't mind the hive mind
match: Every Sliver cascades into another. Welcome to the family. All of it.
I was the first. You'll be the one. Then the next, then the next...
reject: Five colors, one hive mind, and we all agreed: no.
I cascade into better options. You were exiled to the bottom.
The First Sliver.comeback: The hive has reconsidered. Unanimously, as always.

The Gitrog Monster.tagline: someone who brings me a land to sacrifice every upkeep
match: Match! You fed me a land. Ribbit. That's frog for commitment.
It's a match. Every land in my graveyard means another card for us.
reject: Sorry, you forgot my upkeep snack, so I ate the relationship.
No. I'm a frog with deathtouch. Kissing me won't make me a prince.
The Gitrog Monster.comeback: Okay. Sacrifice a land and we'll call it even.

The Ur-Dragon.tagline: someone who can afford a nine-drop with five colors of expectations
match: Match! Thanks to my eminence, every Dragon in my life costs you one less.
I'm the original. Every other Dragon was just a rebound.
reject: I'm a nine-drop. You were never going to cast me on curve.
Sorry, I only date Dragons. It's a whole lore thing.
The Ur-Dragon.comeback: Fine, I'll cost one less for you. Don't tell the other Dragons.

Tiamat.tagline: someone who can handle five heads and five Dragon exes with different names
match: Five heads, and all of them agree on you. That never happens.
Cast me and I'll tutor up five Dragons to meet you. No duplicates, I'm picky.
reject: I fetched five Dragons from the library. You weren't on the list.
Seven mana to cast me and you thought it would be this easy?
Tiamat.comeback: Fine. Four heads still said no, but the fifth one is very persuasive.

Toxrill, the Corrosive.tagline: someone who doesn't mind a little slime on everything they own
match: Match! I'll leave a slime counter on your heart every end step.
It's a match. Your ex's creatures? I'll turn them into Slugs.
reject: Sorry, I melt everything I touch. You'd be a Slug by turn eight.
No. Seven mana of me deserves a table that won't scoop on sight.
Toxrill, the Corrosive.comeback: Fine. One more end step. But I'm leaving slime on your stuff.

Ulalek, Fused Atrocity.tagline: someone who's fine with me being several Eldrazi at once
match: Match! I'm a few Eldrazi fused together, so this is a group date.
It's a match. I'm every color and none, so I fit into any deck.
reject: Sorry, I'm colorless inside. It's not you, it's the void.
No. There are already too many of me in this relationship.
Ulalek, Fused Atrocity.comeback: Fine. We, I mean I, will give you another shot.

Urza, Lord High Artificer.tagline: someone who can keep up with a genius, or at least tap for blue
match: Match! I built you a Construct. It grows with every artifact I own. Romantic.
I started a war with my own brother. You'll be easy by comparison.
reject: I'm a Lord High Artificer. Without my artifacts, you're a 0/0.
Pay five, shuffle, exile the top card. Still more appealing than this.
Urza, Lord High Artificer.comeback: Fine. I'll pay five and play you for free. Don't ask about the math.

Valgavoth, Terror Eater.tagline: someone whose fears I can feed on, ideally forever
match: Welcome to my house. You can check out any time you like, but you'll never leave.
Your opponents' cards don't die near me. They move in.
reject: To get close to me you'd sacrifice three things. You weren't worth one.
The House doesn't want you. And the House takes everyone.
Valgavoth, Terror Eater.comeback: Fine. Stay. The doors were locked anyway.

Vivi Ornitier.tagline: someone who doesn't ask what's under the hat
match: Match! I make free mana every main phase. Dinner's on me.
It's a match. Every spell you cast makes me a little bigger. Keep going.
reject: Sorry, the cEDH table wants me. They're very possessive.
No. Even a 0/3 has to protect itself.
Vivi Ornitier.comeback: Okay... I'm still figuring out what I am. Maybe you can help.

Volo, Guide to Monsters.tagline: someone completely unlike anyone I've dated before
match: A creature type I don't have yet? Fascinating. I'll copy you for my next chapter.
I wrote a whole guide on monsters. You'll be my favorite entry.
reject: I already have your type in my collection. Next species, please.
I'll write that this date went great. My readers expect fiction anyway.
Volo, Guide to Monsters.comeback: Fine. Every guide deserves a revised edition.

Wilhelt, the Rotcleaver.tagline: someone who doesn't mind a little decay
match: Match! People say I look great for someone who's falling apart.
Every time a Zombie leaves me, a new one shows up. You'll fit right in.
reject: Sorry, I prefer partners with decayed. They never stay long.
I sacrificed a Zombie at my end step and drew a card. It said no.
Wilhelt, the Rotcleaver.comeback: Fine. You died a little and came back. That's my love language.

Winota, Joiner of Forces.tagline: a non-Human who can introduce me to Humans, I'm the ultimate wingman
match: Your non-Human attacks and I set you up with a Human. Matchmaker!
I look at the top six and found you. Indestructible, at least today.
reject: I joined forces with six others. None of them were you.
I set up non-Humans with Humans. You I set up with the exit.
Winota, Joiner of Forces.comeback: Fine, I'll put you onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. Again.

Wyleth, Soul of Steel.tagline: someone who loves to dress me up in Auras and Equipment
match: Every accessory you put on me, I draw a card. Spoil me and I'll spoil you.
Steel soul, soft heart. Strap a sword on me and let's go.
reject: Not enough Equipment to stick with you. I need more support than that.
My soul is steel. My answer is also steel: no.
Wyleth, Soul of Steel.comeback: Throw a little Aura on it and I'll reconsider. Okay, reconsidered.

Xenagos, God of Revels.tagline: someone who parties hard enough to double my power every combat
match: Haste, double power, a satyr god as your plus one. Best night of your life.
Show me some devotion and I'll even stop pretending to be an enchantment.
reject: You're not devoted enough to make me a creature. Party's over.
I'm the god of revels. You're the god of leaving early.
Xenagos, God of Revels.comeback: Alright, one more round. Everyone gets haste, even the wallflowers.

Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.tagline: someone whose spells cost three or more, I have standards
match: Match! Cast something big and I'll drain the whole table for us.
It's a match. If anyone loses four life tonight, I'm drawing a card.
reject: Sorry, the Night's blessing doesn't extend to you.
No. Your mana value is under three, and I'm very vigilant.
Y'shtola, Night's Blessed.comeback: Very well. One more spell. Make it a big one.

Yarok, the Desecrated.tagline: someone whose every entrance triggers twice
match: Match! When you walk in, I feel it twice. That's how I'm built.
It's a match. Deathtouch and lifelink: I kill for you and heal you.
reject: Sorry, your entrance only triggered once. I need more.
No. Desecrated hearts don't open for just anyone.
Yarok, the Desecrated.comeback: Fine. Enter again. Let's see if it triggers twice this time.

Yawgmoth, Thran Physician.tagline: someone willing to pay 1 life for this, and a creature, and maybe another
match: The doctor will see you now. Please sacrifice a creature on your way in.
Ideal patient. I draw a card for every friend you lose.
reject: Protection from Humans. Nothing personal. Well, slightly personal.
My diagnosis: incompatible. And sadly, terminal.
Yawgmoth, Thran Physician.comeback: Fine. One more appointment. Bring a creature, I charge per visit.

Ygra, Eater of All.tagline: someone who looks delicious, which, to me, is everyone
match: To me every creature is Food. You're just the tastiest one at the table.
Every Food that dies makes me bigger. We'll grow together.
reject: I looked at you and didn't even get hungry.
Ward: sacrifice a Food. You didn't bring snacks.
Ygra, Eater of All.comeback: Fine. You can stay. But I'm sitting next to the snacks.

match: Match! I'll slip in when you least expect it. That's kind of my whole thing.
Let's reveal the top card of our future. Hope its mana value isn't too high.
reject: This is me ninjutsu-ing out of this conversation. Bye.
I'm not ready to commit. I return to hand at the first chance I get.
Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow.comeback: Fine. I'll swap back in. But ninjutsu stays my emergency exit.

Zada, Hedron Grinder.tagline: someone who buys me one drink and lets me share it with all my friends
match: One Giant Growth on me and every goblin here gets one too. Romantic, right?
One pump spell, twenty copies. Nobody in red is more generous.
reject: I only respond to spells that target me and only me. That wasn't one.
You'd have to target me alone, and you're clearly still looking around.
Zada, Hedron Grinder.comeback: Fine. Point that spell at me, only me, and we'll see.

Zur the Enchanter.tagline: someone enchanting, mana value three or less
match: Match! Every time I attack I find something enchanting. Today it's you.
It's a match. I've been around since Coldsnap. I know what I like.
reject: Sorry, you're above mana value three. I can't fetch you.
No. An old wizard knows a bad enchantment when he sees one.
Zur the Enchanter.comeback: Hmm. Let me attack once more and see what I find.
